cloudflare.summary: Add the Cloudflare adapter with imageService "passthrough", output "server", react() and emdash() with D1, R2, migrations check, MCP on and registry off.
Point main at src/worker.ts and add nodejs_compat, the DB and MEDIA bindings, the EMDASH_SITE_URL var and a cron trigger; no LOADER binding.
Add export const prerender = true to every existing page that should stay static now that output is "server".
If the site has a sitemap, add the article and topic URLs from src/lib/articles/sitemap.ts and serve it on request.
Generate EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY with npx emdash secrets generate --write .env, store it with wrangler secret put, and back it up.
If the site already had this file, add the _emdash live collection to its exported collections.
Include emdash-env.d.ts and worker-configuration.d.ts (from npx wrangler types).

node.summary: Add the Node adapter, output "server", react() and emdash() with SQLite, local storage, MCP on and registry off.
Add export const prerender = true to every existing page that should stay static now that output is "server".
If the site has a sitemap, add the article and topic URLs from src/lib/articles/sitemap.ts and serve it on request.
Generate EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY with npx emdash secrets generate --write .env, set it and EMDASH_SITE_URL in the host's environment, and back the key up.
If the site already had this file, add the _emdash live collection to its exported collections.
Include emdash-env.d.ts, which astro dev generates from the content model.
